translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Noola' na' bayix̱aa nak ba xṉa
Na' xan yabana' ble'id' to dii chonan ka yibanicho. Ble'id' to nool ndobə beeni' c̱he wbilla' ḻe', na' zoa beo'do'na' xṉi'ena', na' nzoa to corona yic̱hje'na' na' llian shlliṉ belj.
Na' noa' noola' to bdo', na' chosyee daa chllagloe' chaz besa' sane'b'.
Na'ch bizle'id' xan yabana' sto dii chon ka yibanicho. Ble'id' to bayix̱' xen inlleb, ba xṉa, na' llia gall yic̱hjb na' zi shi ḻozb, na' twej corona zoa to to yic̱hjba'.
Na' bta xbama' bshibb zan beljdo'ka' llia xan yabana', zi lat'zə ki gokan gashj,
na' bzaḻ'b ḻegakan lo yell-lioni. Na' wze bayix̱aa lao noola' beena' san, kwenc̱he guebb xiiṉe'na' kate galjb'.
Na' noola' wxane' to bi' byodo', bi'na' iṉabia' doxen zbii zkaaṉ yell-lioni na' gom' byen wzenaggake' c̱heb'. Na' Chioza' lii bigoyotie'b' ziyajb' gana' chi'e chṉabi'e.
Na' bxoṉj noola' zeje' gana' bibi chashj chḻeb, gana' ba nonshao' Chioza' to latj c̱he', na' we'gake' dii gawe' to mil c̱hop guiyoa guiyon lla.
Na'tech gok to wdiḻ yabana'. Anjl, beena' le Miguel, na' anjlka' ngoo lall' nee wdiḻ-lengake' bayix̱' xṉana'. Na' bayix̱' xṉana', daa nak dii x̱iwaa, len anjl c̱heyinka' wdiḻ-lengakan ḻegake',
per bi wzogakin gongakan gan. Na' bich bi latj c̱hegakin got' yabana'.
Na' wlejgake' bayix̱' xṉana', daa nak beḻ kani'teyi, daa le dii x̱iw' na' Satanás, daa chziye' doxen yell-lioni. Bzaḻ'gake'n yell-lioni len anjl c̱heyinka'.

Na' benid' wṉe to beṉ' zillj inlleb yabana', wne': ―Ba bllin lla bisla Chios c̱hechona' beṉ' yell-liona', ba bli'e yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen c̱he'na' na' yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱he'na', na' yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱he Crístona', beena' wleje' iṉabia'lene' txen. Ḻa' ba bibejgake' dii x̱iwaa daa chao xya c̱he beṉ'ka' nakcho txen, daa chao xya c̱hegake' lao Chios c̱hechona' ka tella ka waḻ.
Ba bengake'n gan daa chonḻilall'gake' Jesucrístona', Beena' Zaklebi to Xil'do', beena' blalj xc̱hene'na' ni c̱hegake'. Na' bi bllebgake' be'gake' xtilleena', san bzani kwingake' guetgake'.

¡Ka le' zoale yabana', ḻi yiba yizaki! Per ¡nyesh'laz gak c̱hele, le' lle'le yell-liona' na' lo nisdo'na'! Ḻa' dii x̱iwaa ba betjan gana' zoale na' chllaa chlokan nall inlleb daa ṉezin bich bi latj xen c̱heyin de.
Na' ka gokbe'i bayix̱' xṉana' ba bzaḻ'gake'b lo yell-liona', na' blagdob noola' wxan bi' byodo'na'.

Na' bzoa Chioza' c̱hop x̱il noola', ka x̱il bsia xen, kwenc̱he bxoṉjile' dii x̱iwaa na' lljsoe' gana' bibi chashj chḻeb, gana' ba nonshao' Chioza' to latj c̱he', na' we'gake' dii gawe' shoṉ yiz yoo gashjə.
Na' dii x̱iwaa, daa nak bayix̱' xṉana', bem ka bchej nis zil ḻoo cho'aba' gokan to yao kwenc̱he nan wa'n noola'.
Per yell-liona' byaljan kwenc̱he goklenan noola', na' wdeban yawa' daa bchej ḻoo cho'aba'.

Na' daa gok ka', bllaa blokchga bayix̱' xṉana' noola' na' wyajb jtiḻ-lem xiiṉ dia c̱he'na' bgaaṉ, beṉ'ka' chzoa dill' daa nllia Chioza' bia' gongake', beṉ'ka' zoac̱hec̱h chajḻe'gake' cho'a xtill' Jesucrístona'.
Na' wze bayix̱' xṉana' cho'a nisdo'na'.

footnotes.text: Zi lat'zə ki gokan gashjə: literalmente la tercera parte.
